label: Donate
description: The giving page: the ask, where a gift goes, every other way to give and the questions donors ask.

settings.text: Every gift goes into food, fuel for the van and keeping Mill Hall warm.

settings.heading: Give once or every month
settings.text: Our giving page takes cards, bank transfers and digital wallets, and emails your receipt.
feeds a family for a week
cooks a Thursday lunch for thirty
keeps the walk-in fridge running for a month

settings.heading: Other ways to give
settings.text: Gifts by card go through our giving page. For anything else, here is how.

settings.title: Give monthly
settings.body: A monthly gift lets us order food weeks ahead and pay the fridge bill without worry. Change or stop it at any time.

settings.title: Donate food
settings.body: We take tins, dry goods, toiletries and warm coats at Mill Hall on any pantry day. Fresh food from gardens and allotments is welcome on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

settings.title: Fundraise for us
settings.body: Run a race, hold a bake sale or host a supper. We send posters, a collection tin and a thank-you letter for everyone who gave.
settings.link_label: Write to us about a fundraiser

settings.title: Ask your employer to match
settings.body: Many employers match what their staff give. Send us their form and we will fill in our part.

settings.title: Gifts of stock
settings.body: You can transfer shares to us directly. Our treasurer will send the account details.

settings.title: Leave a gift in your will
settings.body: A gift in your will keeps the kitchen cooking for the next generation. Our registration number is in the footer.

settings.title: Give in memory
settings.body: We send a card to the family to say a gift was made, with or without the amount.

settings.title: Will I get a tax receipt?
settings.body: Yes. We email a receipt for every gift of $20 or more within a week, and one summary for monthly gifts each February.

settings.title: Can I change or stop a monthly gift?
settings.body: Any time, from the link in your receipt. Or write to us and we will do it for you.

settings.title: Where do food donations go?
settings.body: Onto the pantry shelves at Mill Hall and St Anne's Hall, usually within the week. Fresh food goes into the Tuesday and Thursday lunch.

settings.title: Can you claim Gift Aid on my gift?
settings.body: No. We are not registered for Gift Aid, so we cannot add it. Your receipt still counts toward your tax return in the usual way.
